title: alphabet@1: a script course for the SquirrelGo character apps
description: alphabets/<id>.json: one script's course for SquirrelGo Alphabets, Kana (hiragana, katakana) or Bopomofo (zhuyin): how it is shown and spoken, its lessons of characters in teaching order, and its articles.

char.description: One character card. Fields after the last one given are left out; a field in between that doesn't apply is an empty string.
The character, or upper and lower case separated by a space ("Ъ ъ").

roman.description: Its romanization (a transliteration for Mongolian, a sound label for Latin, the symbol's name for Zhuyin).

hint.description: Its name and how it sounds.

exampleRoman.description: The example's romanization (its Zhuyin spelling for Zhuyin).

speak.description: Text for text-to-speech when the character alone reads badly; empty to speak the character.

exampleLang.description: BCP 47 tag of the example's language, when it isn't the script's (Latin).

exampleIpa.description: The example's spoken form in IPA, for scripts with no text-to-speech voice.

id.description: The script's key; must match the file name, and the stroke set in strokes/ that draws it.

native.description: The script's name, or a sample, written in it.

lang.description: BCP 47 tag for text-to-speech and recordings.

nonJoining.description: Letters that join to the letter before them but never to the one after. Its presence turns on joined letter forms.

chartFlow.description: Lay the chart out as a flowing row instead of a grid.

audio.description: "ipa": sounds are recorded from the IPA, since eSpeak NG has no voice for the language.

voice.description: The eSpeak NG voice used to say IPA.

bareVowel.description: Where a syllabary's bare vowel sits in the chart.

vertical.description: The script is written in vertical columns.

notes.description: How the course is written and where its values come from, one sentence or line each.

group.description: Lessons in the same group share a chart.

forms.description: false leaves the lesson out of the letter forms table.

builder.description: A syllable block builder (Hangul): the letters that can start, sit in the middle of and end a block, each [letter, romanization].

body.description: HTML: paragraphs, lists, tables and spans with a lang attribute.
